# BE3

## About

? Why should every app need to reinvent live collaborative editing, permissions, accounts, undo/redo, rich text editing, ...etc

! BE3 aims to solve this

## Long term plans / direction

(most of these things are not implemented and do not reflect the current state of the app. this is a general wishlist of the long term vision for the app)

TODO: block-app is offline-first (configurable per workspace, and you don't have to have every file kept synchronzied). but offline edits are not automerged with crdt, instead they use either a regular diff and ask you to merge manually or they automatically merge but based on a regular diff.

TODO: block-app can be end-to-end encrypted. each block has its own encryption key. sharing a tree only shares encryption keys for just that tree. unsharing a tree cycles keys. activating e2e includes a data loss warning that requires you to retype the full warning.

TODO: there is one global workspace for regular users, or at least it feels that way (for shared files to work nicely)

TODO: editors are seperate apps on ios/android. they get access to the main database through a scoped login.

TODO: we have the main combined app, and seperate per-editor apps. the per-editor apps . third parties can have these on their own websites if they want

TODO: wasm editors will work on all clients, even native and ios/android. it will be safe to run untrusted wasm editors. they are sandboxed and get access to sandboxed webgpu for graphics.
- ideally wasm editors are safe enough to run without even getting user confirmation. but gpu access might require confirmation because wgpu security doesn't prevent you from locking up the system by accident.

TODO: we have our own wayland compositor and linux distro.

TODO: user interface state is stored in blocks too. if you restart the app, you stay where you left off.

TODO: blocks can implement their own collaboration modes. we can embed excalidraw and make it so another user automatically starts a live share session. we can embed jitsi meet and have another viewer automatically join the call. we can embed a minecraft save and another user joining automatically starts a lan server and connects to the first user

TODO: we can have non-cooperating app file like blender documents. these warn you when you open them if you are offline or if someone else already has it open, and their conflict resolution is just "ours" / "theirs" like steam cloud saves.

TODO: we have a live hosted service for individual users, teams, and organizations. inside an organization, you can share a file with an entire team

TODO: you can share documents with agents and have them edit them. agents should be run safely, ie on sandboxed vms.

TODO: you can make a website. when you edit a document in it, it prompts you to publush changes?

TODO: the share menu includes anything with access, for example if of is a third party block and the vendor is able to edit its contents without you

TODO: chat. it has to not get slow based on the number of messages.

TODO: we might provide our own ui framework, or maybe egui is good enough

TODO: 3rd party plugin viewer

TODO: components we create require you to know who you're sharing with. eg: for inviting someone to edit a block, both need to confirm, it doesn't show up in an inbox.

TODO: all of the default tools we provide are of reasonable quality for the class of tool they are. if they're not, they're hidden in a menu or opt-in until they get to that target quality.

## Development

See .github/workflows/ci.yml for detailed instructions

Basic setup:

install rustup, `rustup default stable`, install cargo-nextest

```
# run app
./scripts/run

# test app
./scripts/verify

# run for web
./scripts/run --target web

# run for android
./scripts/run --target android
```
